title: Sejong — Travel & Public Services
description: Train ticketing, subway navigation, airport, post office, and banking

items.target: 서울행 기차 표 두 장 주세요.
items.translation: Two train tickets to Seoul, please.
What time is the departure?
Which platform should I go to?
A window seat, please.
Are there any aisle seats left?
Please give me a round-trip ticket.
What time is the next train?
I would like to recharge my transit card.

items.target: 이 호선으로 갈아타려면 어디로 가야 해요?
items.translation: Where do I go to transfer to this line?
Where is Exit 3?
I need to get off at this station.

items.target: 반대 방향 승강장으로 건너갈 수 있나요?
items.translation: Can I cross over to the opposite platform?
What time is the last subway train?
Does this bus go to Myeongdong?
Please let me off at the next stop.
The transfer discount has been applied.
The bus is arriving soon.
Where is the boarding gate?
I would like to check my baggage.
Where is the baggage claim?
Please show your passport and boarding pass.
What is the weight limit for carry-on baggage?
Where is the currency exchange counter?
I would like to check in.
The reservation name is Kim Min-su.
Is breakfast included?
What is the Wi-Fi password?
What time is checkout?
Could I store my luggage?
I left my bag on the subway.
Where is the lost and found center?
I lost a black backpack.
Please leave your contact info and we will call you.
I would like to send this parcel to the United States.
Please send it by international express mail (EMS).
Where is the box packing tape?
How many days will it take to arrive?
I would like to exchange dollars for Korean won.
What is today's exchange rate?
Where is the automated teller machine (ATM)?
I would like to open a bank account.
Please enter your PIN / password.
Please give me some digestive medicine.
I have a fever and a sore throat.
Take it thirty minutes after meals.
Take it three times a day.
I was prescribed painkillers and fever reducers.
What brings you in today? / Where does it hurt?
Please take me to Incheon Airport.
Could you please open the trunk?
